# Honeyraj Singh Thakur

> Personal portfolio of Honeyraj Singh Thakur, a Java Full Stack Developer focused on Java, Spring Boot, backend development, and full-stack applications.

## About

Honeyraj Singh Thakur is a Java Full Stack Developer based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India. Currently pursuing a Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) at Renaissance University, Indore (2023 — 2026). Has practical experience developing responsive full-stack web applications, designing RESTful APIs, implementing database integration with Hibernate ORM, and solving 200+ Data Structures & Algorithms challenges on LeetCode with a focus on clean, scalable architecture.

## Skills

- Frontend: React.js, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Thymeleaf
- Backend: Spring Boot, Microservices, Spring Framework, Spring MVC, Hibernate ORM, JDBC, MySQL, REST APIs
- Languages: Java, C++, C
- Developer Tools: Git, GitHub, Postman, VS Code
